name: Create a registration
description: Create a registration Creates a new Tax Registration object. POST /v1/tax/registrations
context:
POST /v1/tax/registrations
Creates a new Tax Registration object.

name: Update a registration
description: Update a registration Updates an existing Tax Registration object. POST /v1/tax/registrations/{id}
context:
POST /v1/tax/registrations/{id}
Updates an existing Tax Registration object. A registration cannot be deleted after it has been created. If you wish to end a registration you may do so by setting expires_at .
Required: id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Update settings
description: Update settings Updates Tax Settings parameters used in tax calculations. POST /v1/tax/settings
context:
POST /v1/tax/settings
Updates Tax Settings parameters used in tax calculations. All parameters are editable but none can be removed once set.
Optional: body (body)

name: Create a Transaction from a Calculation
description: Create a Transaction from a Calculation Creates a Tax Transaction from a calculation, if that calculation hasn’t expired. POST /v1/tax/transactions/create_from_calculation
context:
POST /v1/tax/transactions/create_from_calculation
Creates a Tax Transaction from a calculation, if that calculation hasn’t expired. Calculations expire after 90 days.
Required: body (body)
